1.en: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses
on account of the fair woman whom he had married
for he had kept himself apart from her.

2.ja: פקאלו. אן כאן מן אגל אלנבווה פתראה וחדה פקט כ'אטבה אללה
2.en: And they said: 'If it be on account of prophecy — was it only he alone whom God addressed?
Has God not addressed us as well?'

3.en: Now Moses was a man exceedingly humble

3.ja: אכת'ר מן גמיע אלנאס. אלד'י עלי' וגה אלארץ'
3.en: more than all the people who are upon the face of the earth.

4.ja: פקאל אללה ג'פלה. למוסי והרון ומרים
4.en: And God said suddenly to Moses and Aaron and Miriam
4.he: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה פִּתְאֹם אֶל-מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל-אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל-מִרְיָם

4.en: 'Come out, the three of you, to the tent of the assembly.'
And the three of them came out.

5.en: And God appeared in a pillar of cloud
and stood at the door of the tent
and called: 'O Aaron, and O Miriam!'
And the two of them came out.

6.ja: אן יכון נבייכמא. אנא אללה תערפת בה פי רויא
6.en: If there be a prophet among you — I, God, make Myself known to him in a vision
or I speak to him in a dream.

7.ja: בל פי גמיע אמתי מחקק הו
7.en: rather, throughout all My nation he is trusted.

8.ja: אן שפאהא אכ'אטבה. ורויא ולא באחאדית
8.en: Mouth to mouth I address him, and by vision and not in riddles
8.he: פֶּה אֶל-פֶּה אֲדַבֶּר-בּוֹ וּמַרְאֶה וְלֹא בְחִידֹת

8.en: and the created forms of God appointed for him — he beholds them.

8.ja: ומא באלכמא לם תכ'אפא. אן תתכלמא פי עבדי מוסי'
8.en: Why then were the two of you not afraid to speak against My servant Moses?'
8.he: וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא יְרֵאתֶם לְדַבֵּר בְּעַבְדִּי בְמֹשֶׁה

9.en: And God's anger intensified against them

10.en: And as the cloud withdrew from the tent
behold — Miriam was white as snow.

10.ja: פלמא אלתפת הרון. אלי' מרים פאד'א בהא ברצא
10.en: And when Aaron turned toward Miriam, behold, she was stricken with a skin-affliction.

11.en: And Aaron said to Moses: 'O my lord
do not lay a sin upon us
for what we did in our ignorance and in our error.

12.ja: לא תכון הד'ה כסקט כ'רג מן בטן אמה
12.en: Let her not be like a stillborn that comes out from its mother's womb
12.he: אַל-נָא תְהִי כַּמֵּת אֲשֶׁר בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵרֶחֶם אִמּוֹ

12.en: with half its body already wasted away.'

13.en: And Moses cried out to his Lord, saying

14.ja: לו אן אביהא בצק פי וגההא. אלם יגב אן תסתחי מנה סבעה' אייאם
14.en: 'Were her father to spit in her face, would she not be obliged to feel shame before him for seven days?
14.he: וְאָבִיהָ יָרֹק יָרַק בְּפָנֶיהָ--הֲלֹא תִכָּלֵם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים

14.en: Let her remain thus outside the camp
and after that she shall rejoin it.'

15.ja: פוקפת מרים. כ'ארג אלעסכר סבעה' אייאם
15.en: And Miriam remained outside the camp for seven days
15.he: וַתִּסָּגֵר מִרְיָם מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים

15.en: and the people did not set out until she had rejoined.

16.en: And after that they set out from Hazeroth
and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
